annotations.title: One strategy: tracked record and back-test

description: Strategist and Strategy Tracker: one Advanced Strategies record, labelled hypothetical. For a 2x strategy the real-days-only numbers since every fund traded come first, then the tracked record (NAV from the start of tracking, windows, drawdown, Sharpe), then the full back-test (windows, statistics, how much of it is simulated), the scorecard against its benchmark ETF, modelled costs and turnover, and the second-source check. Read the tracked record before the back-test: the back-test never ranks. Takes a slug from strategy_list.
name: strategy_record
